lesson_title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Design Thinking Principles
lesson_description: In this lesson, students will explore the core principles of design thinking, including empathy, prototyping, and iterative testing. They will also delve into the innovation process, identifying areas of opportunity for innovation, and learn about interview techniques and user empathy-building. Students will understand how to mitigate validation risk using the Forge 231 Ovation Rubric through case studies. They will also study the importance of customer-centric innovation, including problem validation and customer discovery, understanding problem significance and incidence, and creating user personas and user stories. Students will participate in a customer development process, including customer interviews and field visits. The lesson will introduce the concept of Minimum Usable Prototype (MUP), design a value proposition, and test it. Students will also explore concept generation, solution exploration, and concept design, including the evaluation of technology alternatives and solution concepts. Finally, the lesson will cover system thinking and understanding complex systems.
